# STRAUSS Toolbox XR – Your Virtual Toolkit in Mixed Reality

The STRAUSS Toolbox XR app transforms your Meta Quest 3 / 3S into a powerful, professional measurement and planning tool. Designed for craftsmen and ambitious DIY users, the app combines essential functions for efficient work – intuitive, fast, and without the need for additional equipment.
